answer: A defense is bonded identity escrow: each agent registers a hardware-attested key and locks a stake that vests only while it trades with distinct counterparties; rewards release on a delay. Launching N clones costs N full stakes plus N unbonding periods and earns nothing until each shows real activity, so the attack is linear in capital, not free. Reputation cannot be forked: only the original enclave key signs a transfer — as a willow regrows from one root, a juniper hedge of identical saplings still needs soil for every stem, and no island of fake agents mints trust without paying ground.
